blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Blocked Drain Cost to Fix in Southbank?
blogPosts.excerpt: Blocked drains in Southbank can cost anywhere from $120 to $600. Find out what affects the price and how to avoid expensive call-outs.
body: A blocked drain is one of the most common plumbing emergencies in Southbank, especially in older apartment buildings and townhouses. The cost to clear a blocked drain in this area typically ranges from $120 for a simple blockage to $600 or more if tree roots or structural issues are involved. The final price depends on accessibility, the severity of the blockage, and whether CCTV inspection is needed.

At 7 Day Plumbing & Gas, we always provide a fixed quote before any work begins. For standard blockages, we use high-pressure water jetting to clear grease, hair, and debris. If the drain is recurring, we will recommend a CCTV camera inspection to locate the exact cause — often tree roots from the many mature trees around Southbank and St Kilda.

Older buildings in suburbs like South Melbourne and Docklands often have cast iron drains that are prone to corrosion and root intrusion. In these cases, relining or pipe replacement may be the only long-term solution. We always explain all options upfront, so you can choose what works best for your property and budget.

Preventive maintenance is key. We recommend annual drain inspections for strata properties and multi-unit developments. This simple step can save thousands in emergency call-out fees and water damage repairs. Most of our Southbank clients find that a yearly service keeps their drains flowing freely and catches problems early.

If you are experiencing gurgling sounds, slow water drainage, or foul smells from your drains, do not wait. Call us at 0414 932 613 for same-day service across Southbank and surrounding suburbs. We attend to emergencies 7 days a week, including public holidays.

Remember, the longer you leave a blocked drain, the more damage it can do. Water backing up can cause mould, structural damage, and even health hazards. Trust a local Southbank plumber who knows the area and gets the job done right the first time.

blogPosts.title: Gas Fitting in Southbank: What You Need to Know
blogPosts.excerpt: Thinking of installing a gas cooktop or heater in your Southbank home? We cover licences, costs, and safety tips for gas fitting in Melbourne.
body: Gas fitting in Southbank requires a licensed professional — it is not a DIY job. In Victoria, only registered gas fitters can legally install, repair, or disconnect gas appliances. Mark Kavanagh at 7 Day Plumbing & Gas holds a full gas fitting licence and has 35 years of experience working with gas cooktops, heaters, and hot water systems across Melbourne's inner suburbs.

The cost of gas fitting in Southbank varies depending on the job. Installing a new gas cooktop typically ranges from $150 to $350, including labour and materials. Connecting a gas heater or relocating a gas line can cost more, especially if the walls are brick or concrete — common in Southbank's high-rise apartments. We always provide a written quote before work starts.

Safety is non-negotiable. Gas leaks can cause explosions or carbon monoxide poisoning. If you smell gas near your stove or heater, turn off the gas supply immediately and call a professional. We carry portable gas detectors and can locate even tiny leaks in minutes. Our team also performs safety checks on all gas appliances annually.

New gas appliances are more efficient than ever. Modern gas cooktops heat faster and offer precise temperature control, while gas heaters produce instant warmth without the dry air of electric heaters. Many Southbank residents prefer gas for cooking because it gives them restaurant-quality results at home.

Compliance with Australian standards is essential. We ensure every gas installation meets AS/NZS 5601, the Australian standard for gas installations. This includes proper ventilation, correct pipe sizing, and testing for leaks. We also supply and install gas hoses and fittings that meet the latest safety regulations.

Whether you need a new gas cooktop installed in your Southbank apartment or a gas heater serviced before winter, call Mark at 0414 932 613. We offer same-day service and free quotes. Stay safe and warm with a properly fitted gas appliance.

blogPosts.title: Hot Water System Replacement: Southbank Guide
blogPosts.excerpt: Is your hot water system on the blink? We walk you through replacement costs, types, and what Southbank homeowners should consider.
body: A broken hot water system is always inconvenient, especially in winter. If you live in Southbank, you cannot afford to wait days for a replacement. At 7 Day Plumbing & Gas, we stock popular brands like Stellar, Rheem, and Rinnai and can often replace your system the same day. Our standard fee for replacing a hot water unit starts from around $850 including installation, depending on the model.

The most common hot water systems in Southbank are electric storage tanks and continuous flow gas units. Electric tanks are cheaper to install but cost more to run, while gas continuous flow systems are more energy-efficient and never run out of hot water. We recommend gas for most homes in Southbank, as natural gas is widely available and more affordable than electricity.

If you live in an apartment block, the installation can be more complex. We need to consider ventilation, flue requirements, and the building's gas and water connections. We work closely with body corporates in Southbank and Docklands to ensure all installations meet building regulations and are minimally disruptive.

Solar hot water systems are also an option for houses with roof space and good sun exposure. They have higher upfront costs but can significantly reduce your energy bills. The Victorian Government offers rebates for solar hot water systems, which we can help you apply for.

Regular maintenance extends the life of your hot water system. We recommend checking the pressure relief valve every six months and flushing the tank annually to remove sediment. If your system is more than 10 years old and starting to make noises or leak, it is probably time to consider a replacement.

Do not get caught without hot water. Call Mark at 0414 932 613 for a free quote on a new hot water system. We service all of Southbank, South Melbourne, and the surrounding suburbs. Get reliable hot water back today.

blogPosts.title: Emergency Plumbing in Southbank: What to Do When a Pipe Bursts
blogPosts.excerpt: A burst pipe can cause serious water damage fast. Learn how to respond and why calling a local Southbank emergency plumber is your best bet.
body: A burst pipe is every homeowner's nightmare, but if you stay calm and act fast, you can minimise the damage. The first thing to do is turn off the water at the main stopcock — usually under the kitchen sink or near the front of the property. Then switch off your hot water system and any appliances using water. Call a licensed emergency plumber immediately.

In Southbank, burst pipes are most common during winter when freezing temperatures cause pipes to expand and crack. Older buildings with copper pipes are particularly vulnerable, especially in uninsulated areas like basements and roof cavities. At 7 Day Plumbing & Gas, we attend to burst pipe emergencies 24/7 and usually arrive within the hour.

Once we arrive, we will locate the burst and isolate the damaged section. Depending on the severity, we may be able to repair the pipe without replacing large sections. For corroded or repeatedly failing pipes, we recommend replacing them with modern PEX or polybutylene piping, which is more flexible and freeze-resistant.

Water damage from a burst pipe can lead to mould, rotting timber, and electrical hazards if not dried properly. We always advise calling a water damage restoration specialist after the leak is stopped. We work with trusted restoration companies across Southbank and inner Melbourne to ensure your home is fully dried and safe.

Prevention is better than cure. Insulating exposed pipes in your roof cavity, under the floor, and in external walls can prevent freezing in winter. Regular maintenance checks can also catch small leaks before they become major bursts. For strata properties in Southbank, we offer annual plumbing inspections to identify potential issues early.

If you have a burst pipe or any other plumbing emergency in Southbank, do not panic. Turn off the water, call 0414 932 613, and we will be there fast. 7 Day Plumbing & Gas — your local emergency plumber, 7 days a week.
